# Galatians

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Galatians passionately defends the truth that salvation comes by grace alone through faith alone in Christ alone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 1:10</div>

<div class="identifier">If I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

Independence of the gospel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter defends the divine origin of the gospel Paul preached. The key verse emphasizes that the gospel comes from Jesus Christ, not human invention.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 2:20</div>

<div class="identifier">I am crucified with Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Paul's most quoted verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter defends justification by faith and recounts Paul's confrontation with Peter. The key verse teaches that a person is justified by faith in Christ rather than works of the law.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 3:28</div>

<div class="identifier">Neither Jew nor Greek</div>

### Why This Verse

Unity in Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter explains that salvation comes through faith, using Abraham as the example. The key verse emphasizes that believers are children of God through faith in Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 4:6</div>

<div class="identifier">God hath sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts</div>

### Why This Verse

Adoption

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts slavery under the law with adoption as God's children. The key verse highlights the privilege of sonship and intimacy with God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 5:22</div>

<div class="identifier">The fruit of the Spirit is love</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most memorized passages in the NT

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls believers to stand firm in Christian freedom. The key verse teaches that faith expresses itself through love and the Spirit produces godly character.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Galatians 6:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap</div>

### Why This Verse

Universal spiritual principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides practical instruction for Christian living and service. The key verse encourages perseverance in doing good while trusting God's timing.
:::
